features.name: Virtual Model Routing
features.description: Atomic Virtual Models, capability contracts, fixed/cost-first/random ordering, and fallback chains.
features.verification: pnpm exec vitest run tests/features/virtual-model-routing.unit.test.ts tests/features/route-strategies.unit.test.ts && pnpm test:e2e tests/e2e/virtual-model-routing.e2e.spec.ts --workers=1
features.evidence: 2026-07-16: Route-policy capability mismatch errors now name the exact conflicting values (e.g. maxContextTokens 1000000 vs 1048576) via resolveVirtualModelCapabilityContract, and the route dialog renders precise grouped token counts (formatModelContextTokens) so near-identical context windows are distinguishable instead of both rounding to ~1M. Focused unit (message + formatter), DB + DOM E2E (precise display, 1280/390 no-overflow, enriched error end-to-end), pnpm run verify, and verify:features (9/9) passed.

features.name: Worker Model Operations
features.description: Three durable model/connection jobs plus direct retention and concurrency maintenance.

features.evidence: 2026-07-15: Worker resiliency fixes — H1 self-healing poll loop + process rejection/exception guards; H2 timeout-bounded provider network calls + maxJobDurationMs per-job cap; H2/M1 no-apiKey model-list redirect refusal + auto-reconnecting job_created LISTEN. New unit cases (loop re-arm after claim/terminal-write throw, model-list/price-source timeouts, redirect refusal, max-duration abort, subscription reconnect/stop) pass; pnpm run verify + verify:features re-verified all 9 features with zero regression. 2026-07-14 baseline: focused suites, 85 E2E, and Compose passed.
